title: Copyright Basics for Creators
steps: Identify the original work (video, audio, text).
Understand that copyright exists the moment the work is fixed in a tangible medium.
Consider registering with the US Copyright Office for enhanced legal protection.

title: Protecting Your Brand Name
steps: Search the trademark database for similar names.
Use the 'TM' symbol for unregistered marks.
Apply for a formal Trademark (R) if the brand grows.

title: Dealing with Content Theft
steps: Document the infringement with screenshots and URLs.
Send a DMCA Takedown notice to the platform host.
Contact the infringer directly if appropriate.
